verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible story order (logo, suitcase, headline, subcopy, CTA, legal), but the suitcase is oversized and outweighs the headline. Its backdrop circle has come loose from the suitcase and floats empty in the top-right corner, and the legal block is shrunk to near-illegible micro-type. B is broken: the CTA sits at the very top, ahead of the headline, so the reading order runs backwards. The logo collides with the circle, there is a large unexplained gap between the headline and subcopy, a big dead band sits below the suitcase, and the legal text is unreadably tiny.
